title: Nintendo Virtual Boy
description: A cartridge ROM at $07000000 written as V810 source: flow from the reset slot and the interrupt vectors that hold code, the addresses the code builds with movhi as hi(name)/lo(name) over labels and the VIP's, VSU's and hardware control registers' names, the header (title, reserved, maker, game code, version) field by field.
